original_value: Innovation subsidy is of great significance to promoting enterprise innovation development. However, in recent years, the frequent occurrence of R&D subsidy deception in China has greatly reduced effectiveness of innovation. From the perspective of the strategic choice motivation of the innovation subject (including the enterprises, research institutions, and local governments), this paper constructs a multiplayer stochastic evolutionary game model. The influence of each variable on the subject strategy adoption is analyzed by simulation. There are two important findings in this paper. First, the paper confirms that there is an optimal boundary for the high subsidies received by enterprises and academic institutions, and the “subsidy boundary” is solved through the model. Second, this paper analyzes the effectiveness of the regulation of each variable through simulation and provides management and policy implications.

result.paraphrase: Innovation subsidies are highly important for fostering enterprise innovation and development. Yet in recent years, frequent R&D subsidy fraud in China has greatly weakened innovation effectiveness. From the standpoint of the strategic choice motivations of innovation actors, including enterprises, research institutions, and local governments, this paper builds a multiplayer stochastic evolutionary game model. Simulations are used to analyze how each variable affects subjects’ strategic choices. Two key findings emerge. First, the study confirms that there is an optimal upper limit for the high subsidies received by enterprises and academic institutions, and the model identifies this “subsidy boundary.” Second, through simulation, the paper examines how effectively each variable is regulated and offers management and policy implications.
